summary: Iter-9 backend verification for Satışlar (Sales) module + sidebar merge regression. Added TestSales class (8 tests) covering: (1) auth required on GET /api/sales; (2) nakit (cash) sale creates matching Income record and reduces tire quantity atomically; (3) veresiye sale requires cari_id (400 without), creates cari alacak transaction (NO income), honors line-level discount + overall_discount in subtotal/total math; (4) insufficient stock returns 400 without partially modifying stock; (5) DELETE /api/sales/{id} fully reverses stock, income, cari alacak, logs 'iade' stock movement, and double-delete returns 400; (6) cash-sale delete removes the Income row; (7) 404 cases for missing sale_id and nonexistent tire_id; (8) empty items rejected with 400/422. Full regression against preview URL: Şampiyon chat search_tires tool-trace, /api/inventory/alerts (db.tires threshold=4), cari totals (alacak/borc/odeme/remaining_alacak), /api/sampiyon/import-confirm, monthly report cron/preview/send-now, invoices preview+confirm → all green. Result: 61/61 PASS.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py now 2471 lines — well past the 700-line soft limit; split into routers (auth, finance, tires, sales, cariler, invoices, sampiyon, reports) is overdue.

/api/sales rollback relies on in-process try/except compensation across 3 collections (tires, incomes/cari_transactions, stock_movements). This is NOT atomic — if the server crashes mid-flow the compensations are lost. Consider MongoDB transactions (requires replica set) or at minimum a 'pending_sales' audit record so an admin task can detect orphaned stock movements.

DELETE /api/sales soft-deletes (reversed=True) but GET /api/sales/{id} still returns the reversed sale with no filter. Clients must inspect `reversed` themselves — list endpoint should probably support ?include_reversed=false by default.

/api/sales POST does not round-trip validate: a client could pass a unit_price that differs from the tire's sell_price. This may be intentional (ad-hoc pricing) but is worth documenting; otherwise consider warning if |unit_price - sell_price| > 10%.
Şampiyon tool-handlers still call endpoint functions directly (unchanged from iter-7/8). Service-layer extraction would ease unit testing.
/api/inventory/send-low-stock-email emails all users regardless of role; add role or opt-in subscription filter.
